Future execution must bind the complete fork and dependency sources prospectively and use a separately frozen protocol. Existing observations cannot be retrospectively repriced.
This review establishes scoped software/source fidelity only. It is not scientific admission, a speedup, a finite-cost ratio, or an end-to-end result.
